mapper.sql: id, master_venue_id, asset_type, photo_category, display_order, label, file_name, content_type, size_bytes, s3_key, source_url, provider, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.master_venue_asset (id, master_venue_id, asset_type, photo_category, display_order, label, file_name, content_type, size_bytes, s3_key, source_url, provider) VALUES (#{id}, #{masterVenueId}, #{assetType}, #{photoCategory}, #{displayOrder}, #{label}, #{fileName}, #{contentType}, #{sizeBytes}, #{s3Key}, #{sourceUrl}, #{provider})
mapper.update: UPDATE public.master_venue_asset SET master_venue_id = #{masterVenueId}, asset_type = #{assetType}, photo_category = #{photoCategory}, display_order = #{displayOrder}, label = #{label}, file_name = #{fileName}, content_type = #{contentType}, size_bytes = #{sizeBytes}, s3_key = #{s3Key}, source_url = #{sourceUrl}, provider = #{provider}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM public.master_venue_asset WHERE master_venue_id = #{masterVenueId} ORDER BY display_order, id
